text: The visible design principles and scope establish OutcomeGraph as CLI-first, Git-native, plugin-oriented, safe by default, and resilient under degraded dependencies; the goals are to distill code changes into evidence-backed capsules, verify behavior, replay changed capabilities, keep agent-facing instructions current, and support future workers/oracles/sandboxes without schema breakage, while explicitly not replacing Git, storing full chat transcripts as canonical truth, or silently modifying product code in default mode.
